entries.wording: The shipment has been created by the sender, we are waiting for it to be entrusted to us for dispatch to its destination.
entries.note: The sender booked the shipment and has not handed it over. The first scan.

entries.wording: Shipped from sending Depot. In transit.
entries.note: The sending depot dispatched the shipment, its first physical scan.
Sorted at a hub between the two depots.
At the receiving depot, before the delivery round.

entries.wording: The shipment has not yet arrived at the receiving GLS Depot.
entries.note: A delay notice the receiving depot writes while the shipment is still on its way to it; it can repeat on later days.

entries.wording: The shipment did not arrive at the receiving GLS Depot.
entries.note: The receiving depot's first delay notice for a shipment it expected.
The morning scan of the delivery round; the delivery or a failed attempt follows the same day. The rail's step is In delivery.

entries.wording: Available for collection at GLS POINT.
entries.note: Left at a GLS Point for the recipient to collect. The reply does not name the point.
Delivered, at the door or collected from a GLS Point. The reply adds the masked name of who took it, which is not read.

entries.wording: Parcel not delivered as the consignee was absent, please book redelivery within 3 working days as per instructions provided by email or sms.
entries.note: A delivery attempt failed because nobody was in. The reply breaks it over three lines.

entries.wording: Not in delivery. Awaiting instructions by link included in received email or sms
entries.note: Held at the depot after a failed attempt until the recipient books a redelivery through the link.
A step of the progress rail, labelled Preadvice. Its current step stands in only when the newest scan's sentence gives no stage.
A step of the progress rail, labelled In transit. Its current step stands in only when the newest scan's sentence gives no stage.
A step of the progress rail, labelled Final parcel center. Its current step stands in only when the newest scan's sentence gives no stage.
A step of the progress rail, labelled In delivery. Its current step stands in only when the newest scan's sentence gives no stage.
A step of the progress rail, labelled Delivered. Its current step stands in only when the newest scan's sentence gives no stage.
